what: Transition between sections — for one screen before the boundary element’s head reaches the top of the screen, 14 bands with sawtooth bottom edges (2.5% spacing · 22% depth) slide in, odd rows from the right and even rows from the left, covering the screen (from the top row, each overlapping 58% of its length in sequence). For 1.05 screens after the boundary they exit to the opposite side starting from the bottom row, revealing the next section. Tied to scroll, so it rewinds.

options.stag: Overlap share per row (0~1), default .58 — the smaller, the clearer each row
options.cover: Scroll used to cover (screen-height multiple), default 1 — fully covered when the boundary header touches the top of the screen
options.hold: Scroll held while fully covered (screen multiples), default 0
options.uncover: Scroll used for the lift (screen multiples), default 1.05 (original .6 before + .45 after)
options..fx-zzw__row: Band colors are --kf-raised and a tone darker — for other colors, the using side’s css overrides .fx-zzw__row

use: <section id="team" data-fx="zigzag-row-wipe">…</section> — If the previous section ends pinned to the screen, attach this to an element of the next section
note: The cover is fixed to the screen (end of body, z 40). If a pinned section comes before it, it re-measures after ScrollTrigger refresh. The original starts covering one screen before the end of the previous section’s pin (horizontal strip) and lifts at the next section’s pin start ± (.6 · .45) screens.

from.where: index.js gear band transition (original trans t3 — 14 rows·.58·closeVh 1·leadVh .6·tailVh .45, row height 100vh/14+3vh, odd and even rows in two tones)
